data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Option.AutoBoot
data.value: Start from the inserted disk automatically

data.name: Emulation.Emulator.b2.Description
data.value: Emulates BBC MICRO and BBC MASTER computers.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Peers.Help
data.value: Map remote Econet stations to their IPv4 addresses and UDP ports.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.Rom
data.value: ROM for the memory expansion card

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.Help
data.value: These expansion cards require 32 KiB of main RAM and MOS 1.20. Load the matching ROM for the selected card. Select no expansion before reducing main RAM.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.RequiresMainRam
data.value: This expansion card requires 32 KiB of main RAM.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.RequiresMos
data.value: This expansion card requires MOS 1.20. Select a compatible operating system ROM.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.RomMissing
data.value: The memory expansion card ROM is missing. Select its file in the RAM tab of the machine settings.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.Rom.Help
data.value: Select the control software for this memory expansion from the detected files, or browse for a compatible file. No file is loaded when the path is empty.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.Sideways.Help
data.value: These modules add banked memory without increasing the main memory address space. Select chip images in the expansion sockets to define their contents. Previously selected individual firmware remains in use until its socket receives an explicit chip image.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Memory.Sideways.InvalidImageSize
data.value: Chip image '{0}' has an incompatible size. Expected: {1}.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Station.Help
data.value: Unique Econet station number, from 1 to 254.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Station.Help.Detailed
data.value: Each BBC needs a different station number. This replaces the hardware links on the real interface. Use the Up and Down arrow keys to change the number.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Clock.Help
data.value: Clock frequency of the emulated Econet interface.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Clock.Help.Detailed
data.value: The clock controls the timing of the emulated interface. Different clock settings do not block communication between emulators.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Mode.Help
data.value: Choose the connection used by this station.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Mode.Help.Detailed
data.value: Disconnected: the interface is installed without a network connection. UDP: raw Econet frames between compatible emulators; use it between two AcornEmu stations. AUN: a different Econet-over-IP protocol for compatible servers and emulators. Both ends must use the same protocol.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.BindAddress.Help
data.value: IPv4 address on which this PC listens for network packets.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.BindAddress.Help.Detailed
data.value: 127.0.0.1 connects instances on this PC. To communicate over a local network, use an IPv4 address assigned to this PC, or 0.0.0.0 to listen on all its interfaces. Enter the other PCs in Remote stations. IPv6 and host names are not accepted here.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Port.Help
data.value: UDP listening port on this PC, from 1 to 65535.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Port.Help.Detailed
data.value: The initial port is 32768. Instances sharing the same listening address need different ports, for example 32768 and 32769. Use the Up and Down arrow keys to change the value. Remote stations must specify the destination port.

data.name: Emulation.Acorn.Network.Peers.Help.Detailed
data.value: Write network.station=IPv4:port. For example, 0.3=127.0.0.1:32769 means station 3 on network 0, running on this PC at port 32769. Separate entries with semicolons or line breaks. For another PC, use its local-network IPv4 address. Configure the corresponding return entry on the other station.
